# EXCALIBUR Control Center v0.5.7

Feature and installation release. A native Linux **read-only hardware telemetry
control center** for CASPER EXCALIBUR G870 laptops. Still strictly read-only
telemetry (no fan/RGB/power control).

## Highlights

- **Turkish localisation** — a full translation catalog (186 messages) and a
  **Language** selector in Settings (System / English / Türkçe). The choice is
  applied on the next start; internal settings are still serialised as stable
  English tokens, so switching language never corrupts saved settings.
- **Accessibility / WCAG AA** — theme tokens were adjusted to clear **WCAG AA**
  contrast on cards, and the hand-painted navigation is now exposed to assistive
  technology (accessible name, role and state).
- **Close-to-tray** — closing the window hides the app to the system tray (with a
  one-time hint balloon); **Quit** in the tray menu exits.
- **One-command install** — `scripts/install.sh` detects the distribution, checks
  prerequisites, verifies the asset SHA256 and installs the GUI plus the DKMS
  driver. Supports `--check`, `--version` and `--uninstall`.
- **Source-archive hygiene** — the prebuilt kernel module is kept out of source
  archives and CI fails if a real `.ko` reappears in a package.

## Assets

- **`excalibur-control-center-0.5.7-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst`** — Arch/CachyOS package
  (GUI + integrated `excalibur-wmi` DKMS driver).
- **`excalibur-control-center_0.5.7-1.deb13_amd64.deb`** and
  **`excalibur-control-center-dkms_0.5.7-1.deb13_all.deb`** — Debian 13 (trixie);
  built against Qt 6.8. Internal package version: `0.5.7-1~deb13`.
- **`excalibur-control-center_0.5.7-1.ubuntu24.04_amd64.deb`** and
  **`excalibur-control-center-dkms_0.5.7-1.ubuntu24.04_all.deb`** — Ubuntu 24.04
  LTS; built against Qt 6.4. Internal package version: `0.5.7-1~ubuntu24.04`. The
  two `.deb` sets are **not interchangeable**.
- **`EXCALIBUR_Control_Center-x86_64.AppImage`** — the Qt6 GUI only, built on
  Debian 12 (glibc >= 2.35). Bundles Qt6; **does not** install the DKMS driver,
  needs no root and never touches the system.
- **`excalibur-control-center-0.5.7.tar.gz`** — source archive (driver source and
  GUI sources; **no** prebuilt `.ko`).
- **`SHA256SUMS`** — checksums for all of the above. Download every asset into one
  directory and run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`.

All packages and the AppImage are produced and tested by the release CI. The
`.deb` packages are additionally installed, launched (offscreen) and removed in
isolated Debian 13 / Ubuntu 24.04 containers, which proves dependency closure.

## Install

```bash
# Debian 13
sudo apt install ./excalibur-control-center_0.5.7-1.deb13_amd64.deb \
                 ./excalibur-control-center-dkms_0.5.7-1.deb13_all.deb

# Ubuntu 24.04
sudo apt install ./excalibur-control-center_0.5.7-1.ubuntu24.04_amd64.deb \
                 ./excalibur-control-center-dkms_0.5.7-1.ubuntu24.04_all.deb

# Arch/CachyOS
sudo pacman -U excalibur-control-center-0.5.7-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst

# AppImage (GUI only; install the DKMS driver separately for telemetry)
chmod +x EXCALIBUR_Control_Center-x86_64.AppImage && ./EXCALIBUR_Control_Center-x86_64.AppImage
```

Or use the one-command script (detects the distro, verifies the checksum and
installs the GUI + driver):

```bash
./scripts/install.sh            # add --check / --version / --uninstall as needed
```

## Known limitations (honest status)

- **Fedora:** an RPM recipe exists but is **not published/supported** — its
  install/launch lifecycle was only exercised in a container, never in a verified
  Fedora VM (VirtualBox's unattended install is not compatible with the Fedora
  Workstation Live ISO).
- **AppImage Wayland:** verified under an isolated headless compositor (PASS) and,
  additionally, on a real KDE/Wayland desktop (launches and renders; Qt uses
  software rendering there because EGL is not available in that session).
- **AppImage glibc floor:** built on Debian 12 → requires **glibc >= 2.35**
  (`GLIBCXX_3.4.30`); runs on Debian 12+/Ubuntu 22.04+.
- **Real hardware / kernel API:** live CASPER telemetry is verified on the
  maintainer's real EXCALIBUR G870 with a 7.2.x kernel. CI and containers have no
  WMI/EC hardware. The driver does **not** build against **6.18.x-lts**
  (`BUILD_EXCLUSIVE_KERNEL_MIN="7.2"`), and the module builds only where the
  `wmidev_set_block` / `wmidev_query_block` API exists.
- **`scripts/install.sh`:** install and uninstall were exercised **by hand on one
  real CachyOS machine** (package + DKMS were removed cleanly; the loaded
  `excalibur_wmi` module stayed in memory until unloaded, so this release adds an
  uninstall hint about the still-loaded module). CI does **not** run the script on
  real hardware.
- **Debian/Ubuntu real desktops:** install/launch/remove are verified in isolated
  containers; the complete GUI/telemetry path is verified on the real Arch host,
  not inside a Debian/Ubuntu VM.
- **Secure Boot:** the packages neither generate keys nor sign modules; module
  signing is the user's responsibility.
